en.answer: In this scenario, since the effect of <<4956>> is already resolving when <<4758>> is flipped face-up, the effect of <<4758>> will not negate that of <<4956>>. The effect of <<4758>> will start applying once <<4956>> finishes resolving.
en.question: If the effect of <<4956>> is applied, and a face-down Defense Position <<4758>> is flipped face-up, will the effect of <<4956>> that inflicts damage be applied, or will it be negated by the effect of <<4758>>?
